Traditional CPQ platforms were built for a slower version of B2B sales.

They often require:
>> Months-long implementations
>> Expensive consultants
>> Engineering support for basic changes
>> Rigid approval workflows that don’t adapt as pricing evolves

As a result, quoting becomes a bottleneck.
RevOps loses ownership.
Sales momentum suffers right when pipeline is strongest.

Vendori was built around one core belief: RevOps should own change.
